name: Pomodoro
description: A focus session like Windows Focus: pick the total minutes, optionally split into 22-33 min focus blocks with 5 min breaks, then follow the ring. Breaks and focus periods start on their own. Pause, skip, add 5 minutes, a sound as a break starts and ends, an optional ambient sound (noise, rain, fireplace...) for focus and breaks, a toast at each phase change and a daily tally of focus minutes. Optional webcam timelapse of the whole session (replaces Study Time-Lapse). Survives restarts.
author: AmineChr54
changelog: Ambient sound for focus: brown or pink noise, rain, a fireplace, a soft drone or vinyl hiss, generated live so it never repeats. Pick one for focus and one for breaks (or silence), mix in a second sound, set the volumes; it fades in as focus starts and crossfades at each break. Remembers your choice.

autoContinue.label: Start breaks and focus periods automatically
autoContinue.hint: Off: the session waits for you at each break and focus period.

sound.label: Play a sound when a break starts and ends
sound.hint: A soft chime as a break starts, a brighter one as it ends. The phase toast then stays quiet.

ambientThroughBreaks.label: Keep the focus ambient sound playing through breaks
ambientThroughBreaks.hint: Off: breaks play their own ambient sound (or silence), chosen on the widget.

notify.label: Notify at each phase change
notify.hint: Also set Notifications to On (or Default with notifications allowed in General) for this widget in Settings.
